Making and managing Mastery Missions

How do I create Unit Missions for my students?

Mastery-based practice on the reimagined Khan Academy focuses on Unit Missions. Unit Missions include all the practice items in a single unit in a course. They are great for teachers who want to set up one assignment to monitor their students’ Mastery progress as they work through the unit.

Here are some quick tips about Unit Missions:

  • Once the student gets to Proficient or Mastered in all of the skills in the unit, the Unit Mission assignment will be marked as complete!

  • If you assign more than one Unit Mission, we highly recommend spacing out the Unit Missions to where their due dates are at least 2 weeks apart.

  • If you were previously using Course Mastery goals, here is a resource on how to replace them with Unit Missions Here’s how you can create Unit Missions:

  • Select “Create an assignment” from your Teacher Dashboard or Class Overview

  • Select which course you’d like to assign from

  • Select which unit(s) you would like your students to work on. You can click “Select all” if you’d like your students to work on the entire course.

  • Optional: Drag and drop the units into the desired cadence you’d like your students to follow

  • Set due dates for each unit (don’t worry, you can adjust these later if needed!)

  • NOTE: We highly recommend spacing out the Unit Missions to where their due dates are at least 2 weeks apart!

  • Optional: add a Course Challenge + additional classes that you’d like to see receive these assignments

  • Click “Assign Unit Mission” Reporting options for Unit Missions:

  • The “Assignments” report to see student Mastery progress percentages at the unit level

    • Click “Reports” on the left-hand side window
    • Click “Assignments”
    • Click on the title of the Unit Mission assignment
    • This will open up a chart that lists your students’ Mastery percentage for that unit

  • You can also view Mastery progress data at the unit level on the “Assignments” tab.

    • Click “Assignments” from the left-hand menu
    • Click on a Unit Mission assignment
    • Click “Student summary”
    • This will show when students completed the Unit Mission, how many content items in the Unit Mission they have completed, and the number of Skills Proficient (or Mastered) each student has. We hope this article helped you understand how Unit Missions work!

As a reminder, if you want to read more about the deprecated Mastery Goals and how Unit Missions replace them, we recommend checking out this article: How do I replace Course Mastery Goals in the Khan Academy reimagined experience?

For additional help and support, please reach out to our support team here! We are happy to help.

How do I edit or delete my students’ Unit Missions?

In the reimagined Khan Academy, Mastery-based practice is organized through Unit Missions rather than Course Mastery Goals. Unit Missions show student progress to teachers in smaller chunks, making it easier to spot specific gaps and see exactly where students need support.

In this article, we will go over how to edit and delete Unit Missions.

Editing Unit Missions

First up, let’s go over how to view and edit the Unit Mission you have already assigned. To do this, please follow the steps below:
  • Step 1: Log in to your Khan Academy teacher account
  • Step 2: Select a class, then click Assignments
  • Step 3: Select a Unit Mission, then click the three little dots in front of the Unit Mission you want to edit, and click Edit
  • Step 4: A new pop-up window will appear, and you’ll have the ability to edit the student list and the due date. Click Save.

Deleting Unit Missions

Now, to delete Unit Missions, please follow the steps below:
  • Step 1: Log in to your Khan Academy teacher account
  • Step 2: Select a class, then click Assignments
  • Step 3: Select a Unit Mission, then click the three little dots in front of the Unit Mission you want to delete, and click Delete
  • Step 4: A new pop-up window will appear to confirm you want to delete the Unit Mission. Click Yes, delete. We hope this article was helpful in showing the different features of Unit Missions!

If you would like more information about Khan Academy’s Unit Missions, please check out the resources below:

  • How do I replace Course Mastery Goals in the Khan Academy reimagined experience?
  • What’s changing for teachers in the reimagined Khan Academy experience? For additional help and support, please reach out to our support team here! We are happy to help.

The Mastery System

How does new content affect mastery goals?

Khan Academy is constantly adding new content to the library, and we’re happy to say that we’ve updated the corresponding course and unit mastery systems to reflect the latest updates.

This means that your course or unit mastery goals may have changed, as the number of skills in each lesson, unit, or course may have increased.

Each new skill added to the course or unit will increase the mastery goal by 100 mastery points. Don’t worry, you’ll still have mastered the same number of skills as before, you’ll just have additional ones to complete now, which means you’ll have an even better understanding of the subject that you’re working on!

We’re always working to improve our math mastery systems and, while it is an unfortunate side effect to see the goal rise when we add new content, we try to make these changes when our users will be affected the least in order to minimize disruption to the classroom. We recognize this still isn’t ideal for students, so if you have any ideas or feedback for other ways we could approach this situation, we’d love to hear them!

What are Course and Unit Mastery?

Khan Academy’s mission is to offer a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. In order to move toward this mission, one of the things that the Khan Academy team provides is a system to track students’ learning progress in all courses, all devices, and in many languages. We call this the Mastery System.

Course Mastery

Courses that have Mastery enabled show:

  • The percentage of the course that you have mastered.
  • The overall fraction of mastery points for that course that you have achieved. Courses also have a Course Challenge card at the bottom where you can take an assessment that covers a sampling of skills from the entire course.

Unit Mastery

The Unit page has several elements, which are labeled in the image above:

  • The total Mastery Points available in this unit (for example, 1900 points on this unit— 100 for each skill in the unit)
  • Under Practice, you can also see your progress from Familiar to Proficient to Mastered for each skill.

Practicing to Level Up in Skills and Mastery

When you start an activity (exercise, quiz, unit test, or course challenge), you’ll see a card that quickly shares information about how many questions there will be. If they’re working on a quiz, unit test, or course challenge, they’ll also see roughly how long it took for other students to answer them.

You’ll also see a card after you’ve finished an exercise, quiz, unit test, or course challenge. On the left, you’ll be able to quickly see how many skills you’ve leveled up or down on, as well as how many skills remained at the same level. On the right, you can find a detailed description of each skill level change.

This card may also recommend lessons for you to take based on your performance in the questions.

Skill Levels in the new Mastery System

Each skill is worth a total of 100 Mastery Points. As you practice skills and answer questions in quizzes, unit tests, and course challenges, your level for that skill will go up (or down, if you miss any questions in the course).

Moving to Familiar will earn you 50 of the 100 points. Leveling up to Proficient will get you to 80 points. Become Mastered in a skill to collect the total 100 available Mastery Points.

Mastery is not easily earned, and that’s intentional. But putting in the work to achieve it will prove you’ve earned (and learned!) it. We hope those of you in the Mastery system will enjoy leveling up your skills and reaching 100% Course and Unit Mastery.

What are Mastery Challenges?

Mastery Challenges are a way for you to review and practice skills you’ve previously learned in a course. It’s also another way for you to earn mastery levels, in addition to taking Unit Tests and Course Challenges.

Mastery Challenges aren’t always available. They are unlocked when:

  • You’ve reached the Familiar level on at least 3 skills
  • You’ve reached the Proficient level on at least 1 skill, and
  • It’s been more than 12 hours since you last started a Mastery Challenge (or you’ve never started one). Once unlocked, you can find Mastery Challenges on the main Course page of mastery-enabled courses.

Note: Over time, we plan to introduce Mastery Challenges for all mastery-enabled courses. For now, however, Mastery Challenges are only available in Math courses.

Mastery Challenges always consist of 6 questions that review 3 skills. Mastery Challenges are personalized to you, reviewing skills that you’ve worked on across the entire course and devoting 2 questions to each skill:

  • If you answer both questions correctly, you’ll level up in that skill.
  • If you answer both questions incorrectly, you’ll level down in that skill.
  • If you answer 1 question correctly and 1 question incorrectly, your level in that skill remains the same. Mastery Challenge questions are randomized, which means you won’t necessarily answer both questions for each skill one after another.

You don’t have to finish a Mastery Challenge in one sitting; once you start it, you have 12 hours to complete a Mastery Challenge or it will reset. You can also only complete one Mastery Challenge per 12-hour period.

Why can’t I start a Mastery Challenge over?

You may have noticed that you’re given the option to start over midway through working on a practice exercise, a quiz, or a test. However, the “Start over” link is not available on Mastery Challenges.

Mastery Challenges are special, limited-time tasks that help accelerate your Mastery Progress. Mastery Challenges are there for learners to demonstrate that they’ve fully mastered every skill that makes up a course. For this reason, the “Start over” link is not available on Mastery Challenges.

For more information on Mastery Challenges and how they work, check out this article.

We hope you enjoy using Mastery Challenges to level up on your knowledge, and that you’ll share your feedback as you do so! Please share your thoughts with us in our Support Community or send us an email.

Khan Academy Azərbaycanca Azərbaycan Respublikasının Təhsil Narliyi ilə sıx əməkdaşlıq edir.

Khan Academy Azərbaycanca closely cooperates with the Ministry of Education of Azerbaijan.

Şüar

Hər kəs üçün istənilən yerdə və istənilən zaman pulsuz təhsil. Heç bir uşaq təhsildən kənarda qalmasın.

Missiya

Khan Academy Azərbaycanca missiyasına 2017-ci ildən etibarən başlayıb və bir təşkilat kimi 2020-ci ildə formalaşıb. Bizim missiyamız bütün səhmdarların hüquqlarını qoruyaraq dünyaca məşhur Khan Academy onlayn təhsil platformasının yerli dildə lokallaşdırılmasına nail olmaq və onu asanlıqla əlçatan, aydın və milli təhsil sistemi çərçivəsinə uyğun etməkdir. Təşkilat tədris mövzularının yerli dildə tətbiqi və Khan Academy təhsil platformasının tələbələrə tanıdılması üçün lazımi bütün tədbirləri görəcək. Khan Academy dünya səviyyəli təhsil platforması olaraq dünya təhsil mədəniyyətlərinin dərk edilməsinə töhfə verdiyi və ictimaiyyəti təhsil yolu ilə bir araya gətirdiyinə görə diqqətə və öyrənilməyə layiqdir.

Dəyərlər

Məktəbdən uzaqlaşdırma ilə mübarizə aparmaq, təhsil xərclərini azaltmaq, təhsili hər kəs üçün əlçatan etmək və özünütəhsili asanlaşdırmaq. Cəmiyyətin indiki və gələcək tərəqqisi üçün istənilən mədəniyyətdə təhsilin əhəmiyyətini yüksək qiymətləndiririk. Diqqəti təhsil üzərinə cəlb etməyimizin, asan və əyləncəli təhsil forması yaratmaq istəyimizin əsas səbəbi də budur.

Strategiya

Khan Academy Azərbaycanca öz missiyasını yerinə yetirmək üçün müəyyən sahələrdə tərcümə bacarığına malik olan könüllüləri cəlb edir. Könüllülər birlikdə tərcümə prosessinin ardıcıllığını və davamiyyətini təmin edir və Khan Academy onlayn təhsil platformasının milli təhsil sistemi daxilində tam şəkildə həyata keçirilməsi və lokallaşdırılması üçün çalışır. Khan Academy tərəfindən hazırlanmış davamlı və yenilənən təhsil strategiyası istifadəçiləri və öyrənənləri layihənin icrası üçün tam öhdəlik götürməyə təşviq edir. İnanırıq ki, könüllülərin və bu sahədəki mütəxəssislərin əməkdaşlığı və fəal iştirakı çərçivəsində lokalizasiya prosesini sürətləndirmək, dünya səviyyəli təhsili məktəb daxilində və kənarda olan hər kəs üçün əlçatan və davamlı edə bilərik.

Strategiyaya uzunmüddətli baxış

  • “Khan Academy Azərbaycanca”nın təşəbbüsləri ümumi təhsil strategiyaları və anlaşma yolu ilə Azərbaycan və Qərb ictimaiyyəti arasındakı təhsil əməkdaşlığını möhkəmləndirəcək.
  • Khan Academy tərəfindən hazırlanan hərtərəfli təhsil məzmunun lokallaşdırılması inteqrasiyanı artıracaq, qloballaşmanın mədəniyyət və özünəməxsusluğa vurduğu zərərlərin qarşısını alacaq.
  • Dünya təhsil sistemləri arasındakı oxşarlıqları müəyyənləşdirərək mədəni sərhədləri genişləndirəcəyik. Khan Academy məzmunun ana dilində olması əlçatanlığı artırmaq, dil problemlərini aradan qaldırmaqla yanaşı, milli təhsil mədəniyyətini və ənənələri də qoruyub saxlayır.
  • Khan Academy Azərbaycanca lokalizasiya prosesi zamanı milli təhsil strategiyalarını dəstəkləyir, qoruyur və dünya təhsil məzmununu ana dilində əlçatan edərək yeniliklər gətirir. ~

Motto

Free education for everyone anywhere and anytime. No child left behind education.

Mission

Khan Academy Azerbaijani started its mission since 2017 and as organization it has been launched since 2020. Our mission is to succeed in the localization of the world-famous Khan Academy online educational platform in a native language by making it easily accessible, understandable and suitable for the framework of the Azerbaijan national educational system. The organization will take all necessary actions for the implementation of the educational content in the local language and promote the importance of Khan Academy educational platform for learners. Khan Academy as a world-class education is worthy of interest because it contributes to the understanding of the educational cultures of the world and brings societies together through education.

Values

Combat drop out from schools, reduce expenditure on education, make education accessible for everyone and simplify self-study. We appreciate the importance of education in any culture for the present and future progress of society. That is the reason we want to concentrate on education and create an easy and fun way of studying.

Strategy

Khan Academy Azerbaijani to fulfill its mission promotes and involves volunteers from relevant fields with translation skills. Volunteers all together ensure consistency of the translation process and strive for the full implementation and localization of the Khan Academy online educational platform within the national educational system. The sustainable and up-to-date educational strategy developed by Khan Academy encourages users and learners to make full commitments for the implementation of the project. We believe that in the framework of the cooperation and active participation of volunteers and professionals in the field profound measurements can be adopted and applied to speed up the localization process, make world-class education accessible for everyone and maintain the sustainability of the work in and outside of schools.

Long-term vision of the strategy

  • Khan Academy Azerbaijani initiatives will enhance educational cooperation between Azerbaijani and western societies through common educational strategies and understanding.
  • The localization of the comprehensive educational content developed by Khan Academy will enhance integration and prevent the threat of globalization on culture and identity.
  • Increase cultural bounds through the identification of the similarities between the world educational systems. Making Khan Academy content available in a native language not only increases accessibility and eliminates language barriers but also allows preserving national educational culture and traditions.
  • Khan Academy Azerbaijani during the localization process supports and preserves national educational strategy and brings innovations through the easy way of accessibility of the worldwide educational content in a native language.

Das deutschsprachige Team / The German Team

In 2011, the German team began producing the first German-language videos in the fields of geometry and trigonometry. Over the following years, we expanded offerings, focusing initially on translating mathematics content. Gradually we covered additional subject areas to offer a more comprehensive range of topics. The team also worked intensively to adapt the videos and exercises to the needs of German-speaking learners and to ensure high-quality content.

In 2015, the beta version of the German Khan Academy became available for the first time. This marked a significant milestone, as it was now possible to offer German-speaking users a localized version of the platform. In the same year, the nonprofit association KA Deutsch e.V. was founded. This organization is dedicated to improving educational opportunities in Germany and promoting the dissemination of Khan Academy in the German-speaking regions. The foundation actively engages in content development and adaptation, collaboration with schools and educational institutions, and the implementation of educational initiatives.

For some time now, we have been working intensively to advance the computer science learning content. One of our goals is to subtitle nearly all videos by the summer of 2023.

We are also pleased to mention that our translation community has recently grown. Moreover, several promising projects have been launched.

Det danske hold / The Danish Team

Det danske hold består af en gruppe af frivillige personer med vidt forskellig baggrund, der bidrager, når vi har tid og lyst. Vi har oversat en lang række kurser til dansk især inden for matematik. Vi har oversat det danske folkeskole pensum og udgivet kurser i geometri og algebra. Vi er nu begyndt at oversætte kurser i infinitesimalregning, som vi håber at færdiggøre inden for det næste års tid. Sideløbende er vi begyndt at oversætte kurser indenfor naturvidenskab, hvor vi har færdiggjort to kurser i fysik og er ved at opbygge et fysik bibliotek, der dækker adskillige områder inden for fysikken. Ligeledes er vi begyndt på et kursus i biologi samt et kursus om sikkerhed på internettet.

Vi har desuden lagt dansk tale på over 1000 videoer og er i gang med at lave undertekster til videoer for ældre elever.

Hvis du vil vide mere eller har lyst til at blive en del af det danske hold, er du meget velkommen til at besøge os på Facebook eller sende os en e-mail (khanacademydanishtranslations@gmail.com).

Khan Academy vil gerne takke de mange dedikerede frivillige hvis tid, entusiasme og ekspertise er afgørende for at opnå vores fælles mål hos Khan Academy: at give gratis, verdensklasse undervisning til hvem som helst, hvor som helst.

Vi vil gerne anerkende de oversættere, der i tidens løb har oversat mere end 10.000 ord på platformen.

A equipa em Portugal / The European Portuguese team

A tradução do conteúdo da Khan para português europeu teve início em 2013 por iniciativa da Fundação Altice Portugal (antiga Fundação Portugal Telecom ). Foram traduzidos a maioria dos conteúdos de matemática do ensino básico e secundário (vídeos, exercícios e artigos) e centenas de vídeos de Física, Química e Biologia. Todos os vídeos têm a validação, respetivamente, da Sociedade Portuguesa da Matemática, da Sociedade Portuguesa da Física, da Sociedade Portuguesa da Química e da Inoveduc. Os exercícios de Matemática são validados pela Associação de Professores de Matemática.

Em setembro de 2023, a Fundação Altice terminou a sua colaboração nas traduções para português europeu.

Khan Academy em Português Europeu está disponível em: pt-pt.khanacademy.org

The translation of Khan content into European Portuguese started in 2013 by the Altice Portugal Foundation (formerly Portugal Telecom Foundation). Most of the math content (elementary, middle, and high school) has been translated, and some parts of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology content. All the videos are validated, respectively, by the Sociedade Portuguesa da Matemática (Portuguese Society of Math), the Sociedade Portuguesa da Física (Portuguese Society of Physics), the Sociedade Portuguesa da Física (Portuguese Society of Chemistry) and Inoveduc. The Associação de Professores de Matemática (Math Teachers Association) has validated the Math exercises.

In September 2023, the Altice Foundation ended its collaboration on translations of content into European Portuguese.

Khan Academy in European Portuguese is available in : pt-pt.khanacademy.org

Het Nederlandse/Vlaamse team - The Dutch/Flemish Team

In 2023 nam de Belgische vzw Bibliotheken Zonder Grenzen het project over dat de Stichting Khan Academy Nederlands begonnen was, om te werken aan een vertaling en aanpassing van de wiskunde-inhoud op het platform op basis van de eindtermen van Onderwijs Vlaanderen voor basis- en lager onderwijs. Een groot aantal video’s werd gecreëerd in het Nederlands, en nog meer oefeningen werden vertaald voor het basisonderwijs en secundair onderwijs.

Bibliotheken Zonder Grenzen bouwt daarmee verder op het werk van de Nederlandse en Vlaamse vrijwilligers. Die hebben eerder, onder leiding van Maarten Bruinsma, een grote hoeveelheid lesmateriaal en oefeningen vertaald voor het rekencurriculum van de basisschool, en video’s ondertiteld.

Wil je meer informatie, of wens je als vrijwilliger bij te dragen aan het project? Email dan khanacademy@bibzondergrenzen.be.

We danken alle vrijwilligers die hun tijd en energie bijdragen aan de huidige Nederlandse site (nl.khanacademy.org).

De enorme vooruitgang bij de Nederlandstalige versie van Khan Academy was niet mogelijk geweest zonder de inzet van de fantastische vertalers en proeflezers hieronder genoemd:

Dries Wouters

Estée-Louise Steur

Starting in 2023 the Belgian non-profit Libraries Without Borders took over the work initiated by the Stichting Khan Academy Nederland and began to work on the translation and adaptation of the math contents of the platform, following the standards of the Flemish Ministry of Education for mathematics in primary and secondary schools. Many videos have been created in Dutch, and even more exercises have been translated for primary and secondary school.

Libraries Without Borders builds on the work of an earlier team of Dutch and Flemish volunteers. They translated, under the supervision of Maarten Bruinsma, much of the math content’s articles and exercises for the primary school math curriculum, and subtitled videos.

Do you want more information, or do you wish to volunteer? Then email khanacademy@bibzondergrenzen.be.

We thank all the volunteers who contribute their time and energy to make the existing Dutch site (nl.khanacademy.org) possible.

L’équipe francophone / The French Team

Libraries Without Borders (Bibliothèques Sans Frontières) implements the French adaptation of Khan Academy’s resources. This French version obviously concerns France but also all the French-speaking countries in the world.

More than 5000 video lessons have been adapted since the beginning of September 2013. In mathematics almost all the videos of Khan Academy are now translated into French. You will find all the necessary content for the primary, middle and high school levels. About a thousand videos of physics, chemistry, biology, medicine and computer science are now translated, too. In addition to videos, more than 200,000 interactive and innovative exercises and lessons have been translated to support student learning. All content is reviewed and validated by a scientific committee made up of French and Belgian professors and specialists in digital education, so that the programs, methods and examples are compatible with what is taught in French classes. The curricula of the French and Belgian classes are updated regularly on the site to facilitate the work of correspondence between the contents of the platform and the official programs.

The tremendous progress that the Khan Academy French version has made would not be possible without the contributions of these phenomenal translators and proofreaders shown below.

Latviešu valodas komanda / The Latvian team

  1. gadā mēs uzsākām darbu pie Khan Academy platformas Latviešu valodas versijas. Pirmais kurss, kas ir pieejams mūsu lietotājiem, ir “Aritmētika”. Mēs izvēlējāmies šo kursu, jo tieši tas satur tēmas, kas nereti pārsteidz skolēnus nesagatavotus. Dati liecina, ka negatīvie skaitļi un daļskaitļi daudziem skolēniem kļūst par klupšanas akmeni un tieši šajās tēmās būtu ļoti vērtīgi viņiem sniegt atbalstu. Khan Academy sistēma, kas īsteno meistarības apguves pieeju (mastery learning), var nodrošināt efektīvu pašmācības procesu šo grūtību pārvarēšanā.

Darbs pie latviešu valodas versijas ir tikai sācies, un priekšā vēl ir daudz jaunumu. Priecāsimies par jūsu atsauksmēm un ieteikumiem! Apmeklējiet un sekojiet līdzi jaunumiem mūsu Facebook lapā: Khan Academy kopiena Latvijā.

Liels paldies visiem projektā iesaistītajiem — projekta komandai un atbalstītājiem — par nerimstošu enerģiju, pozitīvismu, profesionalitāti un vēlmi palīdzēt augt izglītībai Latvijā!

In early 2020, we started working on the Khan Academy Latvian language site. The first course that is available to our users is Arithmetic. We chose this course because it contains challenging topics that often take our students by surprise. Data show that negative numbers and fractions become a painful struggle and it would be very important to provide extra support on these topics. The Khan Academy system, based on mastery learning principles, can ensure an effective self-paced learning process to overcome these obstacles.

Latvian language advocate: Pāvils Jurjāns

Lietuvių komanda / The Lithuanian Team

The Lithuanian version of Khan Academy now offers the Early Math course, which contains videos and exercises for primary school students.

The active translation work of the Khan Academy platform started at the end of 2019 when Julius and Osvaldas joined the team. Soon after the breakout of the COVID-19 pandemic, the interest in Khan Academy grew significantly, and more volunteers got involved. Khan Academy brought us together for a common purpose, and our team has now grown into a non-profit organization Fondas 17 that will continue to deliver on Khan Academy’s mission and help reach eager learners and teachers in all corners of Lithuania.

We hope to offer many more Khan Academy lessons in the future. Follow our news by joining the community on our Facebook page.

„Khan Academy“ lietuviškos versijos naudotojai jau gali pasidžiaugti „Ankstyvosios Matematikos“ kursu, kuriame yra surinktos pamokos ir užduotys skirtos pradinukams.

Aktyviai versti „Khan Academy“ platformą pradėjome 2019 metų pabaigoje prie komandos prisijungus Juliui ir Osvaldui. Netrukus pasaulį užgriuvus COVID-19 pandemijai, susidomėjimas „Khan Academy“ ženkliai išaugo ir į projektą įsitraukė daugiau savanorių. Khan Academy mus subūrė bendram tikslui, o dabar mūsų komanda išaugo į ne pelno siekiančią organizaciją Fondas 17 , kuri ir toliau vykdys Khan Academy misiją bei padės pasiekti mokinius ir mokytojus visuose Lietuvos kampeliuose.

Mūsų veikla dar tik įgauna pagreitį, tad ateityje tikimės pasiūlyti kur kas daugiau kokybiško turinio. Junkitės prie mūsų bendruomenės ir sekite naujienas mūsų Facebook puslapyje.

A magyar csapat / The Hungarian Team

Az önkéntes fordítókból és lektorokból álló magyar csapat két éves elhivatott munkája eredményeként 2019. nyarán megnyílt a magyar nyelvű Khan Academy. A honlapon elérhető tananyagokat folyamatosan bővítjük. További információért kérjük látogasson el az Akadémia Határok Nélkül Alapítvány honlapjára.

A Khan Academy szeretné köszönetét kifejezni minden olyan önkéntesnek, aki idejét, energiáját és szakértelmét szentelte küldetésünk teljesítéséhez: világszínvolnalú oktatáshoz való hozzáférés biztosítása bárki számára, bárhol, ingyen.

Külön elismeréssel szeretnénk kiemelni csapatunk azon tagjait, akik a magyar tananyagok létrejöttéhez legalább 10000 szó vagy 10 videó fordításával járultak hozzá.

Thanks to two years of outstanding work by the Hungarian team of volunteer translators and proofreaders, the Hungarian version of Khan Academy was launched in Summer 2019. The website continues to grow with the addition of new content. For more information about our work please visit the website of our foundation: Akadémia Határok Nélkül (Academy Without Borders).

Khan Academy would like to thank all the volunteers who’ve dedicated their time, energy, and expertise to our mission: a free, world-class education for anyone, anywhere.

Nhóm Việt Nam / The Vietnamese Team

At The Vietnam Foundation, we strive to improve the lives of Vietnamese people through education. After 12 years and a string of 3 successful non-profit educational projects, in 2020, we launched a project to translate Khan Academy’s educational contents into Vietnamese, with the mission of bringing cost effective and scalable education to Vietnam. We aspire to transcend any obstacles that come between students and equality of opportunity in education by providing a free, online educational platform which facilitates students accessibility from anywhere.

In pursuing this mission, we have been connecting and collaborating with young individuals and organizations with the same vision and calling for educational equity in Vietnam and around the globe. This shared vision has helped us to form a community full of passion and talent. Their contributions have built the momentum for the project to reach new milestones.

We would like to express our gratitude to the hundreds of interns and volunteers, as well as the organizations that have aided Khan Academy in moving closer to the goal of bringing valuable online resources to students all over the country. To see the complete list of individuals and organizations who have contributed to this project, please visit The Vietnam Foundation’s website.

–

The Vietnam Foundation là một tổ chức phi lợi nhuận với sứ mệnh nâng cao chất lượng cuộc sống của người Việt thông qua giáo dục. Nối tiếp thành công của 3 dự án phi lợi nhuận trong 12 năm hoạt động, từ năm 2020, chúng tôi khởi động dự án Việt hoá các nội dung bài giảng của Khan Academy, nhằm thực thi sứ mệnh mang đến một nền tảng giáo dục miễn phí và chất lượng đến với tất cả học sinh Việt Nam. Chúng tôi mong muốn có thể xoá bỏ mọi rào cản, phá vỡ sự bất bình đẳng trong giáo dục thông qua việc mang đến một nền tảng học trực tuyến hoàn toàn miễn phí mà học sinh có thể truy cập từ bất kỳ đâu.

Để thực hiện sứ mệnh lớn lao này, chúng tôi đã có cơ hội kết nối và hợp tác với những bạn trẻ, những tổ chức có cùng tầm nhìn và sứ mệnh đem lại một nền giáo dục công bằng ở Việt Nam và trên toàn thế giới. Sứ mệnh chung này đã giúp chúng tôi xây dựng được một cộng đồng đầy nhiệt huyết và tài năng. Những đóng góp không ngừng nghỉ của họ đã thúc đẩy dự án đạt được nhiều cột mốc đáng tự hào.

Chúng tôi muốn gửi lời cảm ơn chân thành đến hàng trăm bạn thực tập sinh và tình nguyện viên, cũng như tất cả những tổ chức đã và đang hỗ trợ dự án tiến gần hơn đến mục tiêu đem lại những tài nguyên trực tuyến đầy giá trị đến học sinh toàn quốc. Để xem danh sách đầy đủ những cá nhân và tổ chức đã đóng góp cho dự án, vui lòng truy cập trang web The Vietnam Foundation.

O time Brasil / The Brazilian Portuguese team

Desde 2014 o projeto de localização da Khan Academy no Brasil conta com a colaboração de diversos tradutores e revisores voluntários, cuja dedicação faz com que cada vez mais pessoas tenham acesso ao conteúdo do nosso site.

A Khan Academy agradece a todos os voluntários que dedicaram seu tempo, energia e conhecimento para contribuir com nossa missão: educação gratuita e de alta qualidade para todos, em qualquer lugar.

Since 2014, the Brazilian Localization Project has been a collaboration of many volunteers, translators and proofreaders, whose dedication allows more and more people to use our site in Brazilian Portuguese.

Khan Academy would like to thank all the volunteers who’ve dedicated their time, energy, and expertise to our mission: a free, world-class education for anyone, anywhere.

Oʻzbekiston jamoasi / The Uzbek Team

Founded on January 21, 2019, the non-government non-profit organization “Bilim Onlayn” is working on the localization of Khan Academy into the Uzbek language. Having gathered around 150 volunteers from different corners of the world under the mission “A free, world-class education for everybody, everywhere and forever”, the Khan Academy Uzbek team is striving to make a positive shift in the education sphere of Uzbekistan by providing the nation with high quality, free content in their native language.

We would like to thank our translators, proofreaders and teachers, who at this time have translated almost 4 million words and record nearly 1,000 video lessons. In addition, we would like to recognize our phenomenal managing team and all those who helped and continue supporting us in making Khan Academy content available in Uzbek.

We still have much to do and are ready for collaboration. For any additional information on our project, please visit our Facebook page and website.

Türk takımı / The Turkish Team

Khan Academy Türkçe was launched in 2012 as one of Khan Academy’s first international partnerships with an aim to make all Khan Academy content available for Turkish learners around the world. Khan Academy Türkçe is a non-profit organization, sponsored by the Foundation for Translation of Scientific and Technical Publications, an STFA Group Foundation, established in 1992 with a mission to support education in Turkey. The STFA Group is one of the most rooted conglomerates in the Republic of Turkey with over 80 years of history. From a corporate social responsibility point of view, STFA decided to sponsor Khan Academy’s localization efforts into Turkish in order to celebrate the company’s 75th anniversary, in 2013.

With a goal to provide equal opportunities for all in Turkish education, Khan Academy Türkçe features over 8000 Khan Academy video lessons in Turkish, which have been translated by more than 500 volunteers. Khan Academy Türkçe has delivered over 100 million online lessons, reaching out to 15 million learners in Turkey. Today, Khan Academy Türkçe educational content reaches out to thousands of schools all around Turkey through a collaboration with the Ministry of Education. We believe that education is a fundamental human right. Therefore, Khan Academy Türkçe video lessons feature optional subtitles for the hearing impaired learners. You only have to know one thing: you can learn anything!

Khan Academy Türkçe

Khan Academy Türkçe 2012 yılında Khan Academy’nin ilk uluslararası iştiraklerinden biri olarak kuruldu. STFA Grubu’nun girişimiyle, kar amacı gütmeyen bir kuruluş olarak İstanbul ofisi ile hayat bulan Khan Academy Türkçe, bir STFA Vakfı olan Bilimsel ve Teknik Yayınları Çeviri Vakfı çatısı altında faaliyet göstermektedir. 80 yılı aşkın tarihi ile Türkiye’nin en köklü şirketlerinden olan STFA’nın üst yönetimi, kurumsal sosyal sorumluluk yaklaşımıyla şirketin 75. yıl dönümünü kutlamak için Khan Academy’yi Türkçe’ye kazandırarak, Türkiye ve tüm dünyada Türkçe konuşan herkese hizmet verecek bir eğitim kaynağını ücretsiz olarak erişilebilir kılmayı amaçlamıştır.

Türkçe eğitimde fırsat eşitliğinin güçlenmesine katkı sunmayı hedefleyen Khan Academy Türkçe, 500’den fazla gönüllünün desteği ile bugüne kadar 8000’den fazla Khan Academy eğitim videosunu Türkçeleştirdi ve tamamen ücretsiz olarak yayınladı. Hayat boyu öğrenme anlayışı çerçevesinde her yaş için sunduğu geniş kütüphane ile Türkiye’nin en önemli dijital eğitim kaynakları arasında yer alan Khan Academy Türkçe, geride bıraktığımız süre zarfında 100 milyondan fazla ders vererek 15 milyon insanın hayatına dokundu. Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı ile yapılan işbirliği kapsamında Khan Academy’nin Türkçe olarak sunduğu dersler bugün Türkiye’deki tüm okullara ulaşıyor. Eğitimin her birey için temel bir hak olduğu düşüncesiyle işitme ve görme engelli bireyler için de çözüm üretmek için elimizden gelen gayreti gösteriyoruz. Ülkemizin genç ve teknolojiyle barışık nüfusunun eğitim teknolojilerinden önemli fayda sağlayabileceğine inanıyor ve onlara sesleniyoruz: Tek bir şeyi bilmelisin, her şeyi öğrenebilirsin!

Český tým / The Czech Team

Khanova skola is a Czech non-profit organization founded in 2012 with a mission of promoting free educational platform khanacademy.org. The main activity of Khanova skola is the localization of the platform and its content for use in Czech environment. Furthermore, Khanova skola has been active in promoting digital open educational resources and modern pedagogical methods.

Main activities of Khanova skola

  • Since 2012 Khanova skola has localized (translated into Czech):
    • 1000 videos (plus more than 4000 subtitled videos),
    • 500 exercises in Czech at cs.khanacademy.org,
    • Khan Academy Mobile App for Android and iOS.
  • In Khanova skola’s existence, the organization has organized:
    • more than 15 translation marathons in cooperation with Czech universities, with volunteers subtitling educational videos from Khan Academy,
    • a competition “Umis ucit, ukaz se!” for creators of educational videos as a part of Google for education programme,
    • translation clubs at high schools,
    • workshops for video creators,
    • workshops about using Khan Academy and Khanova skola in class. Khanova skola was supported by the foundation Nadace Unipetrol in order to translate Organic Chemistry content.

The main sponsor of Khanova skola is Bakaláři Software.

The tremendous progress that the Khan Academy Czech version has made would not be possible without the contributions of these phenomenal translators, proofreaders, and video creators shown below.

Spolek Khanova škola vznikl v roce 2012 s cílem propagace a podpory bezplatného vzdělávacího webu khanacademy.org. Hlavní činností je lokalizace této platformy a jejího obsahu pro potřeby českého prostředí. V neposlední řadě se Khanova škola zasazuje o propagaci alternativních forem vzdělávání v českém prostředí.

Jaké jsou hlavní aktivity spolku

  • Od roku 2012 Khanova škola lokalizovala (přeložila do češtiny):
    • přes 1000 videí a další 4000 videí opatřila českými titulky,
    • přes 400 českých interaktivních cvičení,
    • mobilní aplikaci Khan Academy (iOS i Android).
  • Za dobu svého fungování spolek uspořádal:
    • více než 15 překladatelských maratonů ve spolupráci s českými univerzitami (UK, ČVUT, VŠCHT, MU, UPOL), na kterých dobrovolníci titulkovali výuková videa Khan Academy,
    • soutěž “Umíš učit, ukaž se!” pro tvůrce výukových videí v rámci programu Google pro vzdělávání,
    • překladatelské kroužky na středních školách,
    • pravidelné workshopy pro zájemce o tvorbu výukových videí,
    • pravidelné workshopy i webináře o využití Khan Academy. Překlad organické chemie podpořila Nadace Unipetrol.

Dlouhodobým sponzorem Khanovy školy je společnost Bakaláři. V roce 2020 se spolek Khanova škola stal partnerem společnosti Bakaláři v realizaci projektu “Khan Academy pro střední školy” s podporou ESF OPVVV MŠMT.

Η Ελληνική Ομάδα / The Greek Team

The Khan Academy Greek localization initiative began in 2010, and is led by Mathaino.org, a US-based non-profit organization. Our mission is to bring the Khan Academy platform and learning pedagogies to every student and teacher in Greece and throughout diaspora, free of charge. As part of our extended mission to learn how to best use the platform in K-12 classrooms and after-school programs, our core team members have been working with teachers and educational experts on processes and interventional models needed to affect positive change in students’ lives by maximizing their in-class and remote learning experience. Specifically, since 2014, we have been using the platform in after-school programs to develop the best data driven personalization models that will enhance students’ academic performance and ensure a long-lasting learning experience in K-12, and beyond.

Българският екип / The Bulgarian Team

Сдружение “Образование без раници“ се е посветило на това да работи за образование на бъдещето в България и да дава достъп до глобално знание – безплатно и за всички.

Един от важните проекти на организацията е локализацията, популяризирането и прилагането в България на най-голямата образователна платформа в света – Кан Академия, също така напълно безплатна за всички. На българската версия вече са достъпни над 6000 видео урока, както и десетки хиляди упражнения и статии по математика, компютърно програмиране и компютърни науки, биология, химия, физика, здраве и медицина, астрономия, световна история, музика, философия, екология. Предстои превод на останалото съдържание на платформата, според привлеченото финансиране и ресурс.

“Образование без раници” консултира институциите в България, включително министерството на образованието, относно цялостния процес на дигитализация и обучението в дигитална среда. Сдружението провежда и обучения на учители и училищни колективи за използването на Кан Академия и други глобално наложени безплатни дигитални ресурси и иновативни образователни практики. Също така, “Образование без раници” организира за учениците в цяла България безплатни онлайн състезания по различни учебни предмети с Кан Академия, насърчаващи ученето. За повече информация за дейността на сдружението можете да разгледате нашия сайт obr.education или нашата фейсбук страница facebook.com.

От името на целия екип на сдружение “Образование без раници” благодарим на всички хора, които ни помагат с превода, редакциите, разпространението, привличането на партньори и финансиране за Кан Академия на български език! Без вас нямаше да напреднем толкова много за толкова кратко време!

В списъците по-долу споменаваме всички, които са допринесли за нашата кауза с някоя от следните дейности:

  • с преводи (над 10 клипа или над 10 000 думи от упражнения и статии), редакции и дублажи/монтажи на съдържанието

  • с експертна помощ по математика, физика, химия, биология, здраве и медицина, музика, информатика, история и философия

  • с координация и друг вид организационна, комуникационна и експертна помощ

Ако случайно сме пропуснали някого или не искате името ви да присъства в списъка, моля свържете се с нас на hi@obr.education.

Специални благодарности за Красимира Илиева, която досега е превела над 3 милиона думи!

Екип сдружение “Образование без раници”

The Education Without Backpacks Association is dedicated to building the education of the future in Bulgaria and giving access to global knowledge - free of charge for all. One of the main projects of the organization is the localization, awareness and adoption of Khan Academy.

More than 6,000 video lessons, as well as tens of thousands of exercises and articles in mathematics, computer programming and computer science, biology, chemistry, physics, health and medicine, astronomy, world history, music, philosophy, and ecology are now available on the Bulgarian version (https://bg.khanacademy.org/). The rest of Khan Academy content will follow, according to the resources and funding received.

Education WIthout Backpacks advises Bulgarian institutions, including the ministry of education, about the digitalization of education as well as online education/ education in digital environment, in general. The association also conducts trainings for teachers and school teams on the use of Khan Academy and other globally-established, free digital resources and innovative educational practices. Moreover, Education Without Backpacks organizes free online contests on Khan Academy in different subjects, targeting all students across Bulgaria. For more information, check the website of the organization obr.education and its Facebook page facebook.com.

On behalf of the team of Education Without Backpacks, we would like to thank all the people who have helped us and continue to support us in making Khan Academy successful in Bulgarian!

Without you, we would not have done so much in such a short time!

Below we mention these key contributions:

  • translations (10+ videos or 10,000+ words from exercises and articles), proofreading, and dubbing/video editing

  • expert help in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Health and Medicine, Music, Computer science & Programming, History, and Philosophy

  • coordination, communication and other expert activities and organizational assistance.

If we missed someone accidentally or in case you don’t want your name to be on this list, please send an email to hi@obr.education.

Our special thanks go to Krasimira Ilieva, who has single-handedly translated over 3 million words so far!

Русскоязычная команда / The Russian Team

С начала 2018 некоммерческая организация EducationX старается перевести и адаптировать видео материалы и научные статьи с официального сайта Академия Хана на русский язык. В этом сложном и непростом деле, нам помогают волонтеры и благодаря их помощи мы смогли перевести на русский язык огромную часть материала.

В настоящее время мы занимаемся тем, что переводим образовательные статьи и задания к разным разделам, чтобы на нашем сайте помимо просмотра обучающих видео, можно было бы также решать разные задания. Поэтому нам просто необходима ваша помощь! Перевод осуществляется на волонтёрской основе небольшой командой энтузиастов. Если вы владеете русским и английским языками и у вас есть свободное время, то вы можете присоединиться к нам и помочь с переводом! Для этого можно связаться с нами через группу во Вконтакте: vk.com

Вместе мы сделаем образование лучше!

Since 2018, the non-profit organization EducationX with the collaboration of many volunteers, who give generously of their time and energy, has already translated thousands of words and videos into Russian.

However, we plan on adding more materials, therefore we are currently engaging in a big effort to translate not only videos, but articles, quizzes, and discussion areas where people can comment and communicate with each other. If you want to help us to translate our content into Russian, please contact us and join our group in Vkontakte: vk.com.

We would love to have you on our team!

We would like to recognize these contributors:

Christine Lumen

Nikita Ivanov

Irina Voronova

Vasily Merzlyakov

Sergey Pshebelsky

Mykyta Solonko

Українська команда / The Ukrainian Team

Education determines a society’s future. But for the third year Ukraine has been at war, leaving 1 in 4 children not able to go to school in person. The KSE Foundation is stepping up to translate free, world-class educational material from Khan Academy for every child in Ukraine.

The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted education worldwide, but for Ukrainian students from rural areas, the challenges have been particularly severe. According to PISA-2022, these students are lagging their city peers by 4.5 years in mathematics.

The situation has only worsened due to the ongoing war in Ukraine. The war has damaged 3,798 educational institutions, with 365 of them destroyed. In cities like Kharkiv, which face constant bombardment, students are often forced to study in underground schools. Their education is frequently interrupted by daily air-raid alarms and shellings, making consistent learning a difficult feat.

Despite these challenges, efforts are being made to support Ukrainian students and bridge the educational gap. By providing resources and innovative learning solutions, we aim to help these students continue their education and achieve their full potential, even in the face of adversity.

We believe in doing what we can to support Ukrainian children. By providing access to Khan Academy’s free, world-class education, we can ensure that any child with access to a shelter, internet connection, and a laptop or smartphone can continue their learning journey.

Our dedicated team of 39 people—including translators, video creators, auditors, and editors—has already completed our first course: Algebra Basics. We’re currently working on Precalculus and Arithmetic, with the goal of covering the entire school curriculum as soon as possible. This way, students can access high-quality resources even if they can’t learn from a teacher, empowering them to help rebuild our country after victory.

Your support can make a real difference for Ukrainian children. To learn more about our initiative and support us, visit foundation.kse.ua

We are incredibly grateful to our team members who are working hard to make Khan Academy’s free, world-class education available to every student, parent, and teacher in Ukraine.

Հայալեզու թիմ / The Armenian Team

2017 թվականի հուլիսին «Այբ» կրթական հիմնադրամը մեկնարկեց «Քան» ակադեմիայի հարթակի տեղայնացման ծրագիրը՝ հայ աշակերտներին և ուսուցիչներին հայերենով ու անվճար հասանելի դարձնելով համաշխարհային որակյալ կրթական ռեսուրսներ։

«Քան» ակադեմիայի հայկական հարթակի ստեղծումը, տեղայնացումը և մաթեմատիկայի բաժնի տեղայնացումը հնարավոր դարձավ «Վերածնունդ» մշակութային և ինտելեկտուալ հիմնադրամի աջակցությամբ և ֆինանսավորմամբ, այնուհետև տարբեր կազմակերպությունների մասնակցությամբ և ֆինանսավորմամբ իրականացվեց տեղայնացվող բաժինների ու կրթական նյութերի ընդլայնում, ինչպես նաև ակտիվ աշխատանքներ մեկնարկեցին շահառու խմբերի հետ․

  • Եվրոպական միության կողմից ֆինանսավորվող «ԵՄ-ն հանուն երիտասարդների. ՍԵՅ ԵՍ հմտություններ աշխատանքի համար» ծրագրի շրջանակում (Վորլդ Վիժն Հայաստանի համաֆինանսավորմամբ և աջակցությամբ) թարգմանվել և տեղայնացվել են ուսուցողական նյութեր «Քան» ակադեմիայի նոր բաժիններից, մասնավորապես` արվեստներից և հումանիտար գիտություններից, ձեռնարկատիրությունից և ֆինանսներից, համակարգչային գիտության և ծրագրավորման բաժիններից։

  • Հայաստանում ԱՄՆ դեսպանատան ֆինանսավորմամբ մեկնարկել են գիտության առարկաների, մասնավորապես՝ ֆիզիկայի և օրգանական քիմիայի նյութերի տեղայնացման աշխատանքները, ինչպես նաև Գյումրու բնագիտական և մաթեմատիկայի առարկաների շուրջ 40 ուսուցիչների վերապատրաստումները և հանրակրթական դպրոցներում սովորող շուրջ 900 աշակերտների հետ աշխատարանները՝ ուղղված «Քան» ակադեմիայի հարթակի կիրառմանը դասավանդման և ուսման գործընթացներում։

  • «Մարդը կարիքի մեջ» ընկերության կողմից իրականացվող «ԵՄ Covid-19 հետևանքների չեզոքացման աջակցությամբ ծրագիր արևելյան գործընկերության երկրների համար» ծրագրի շրջանակում հանրակրթական դպրոցներից 1500 աշակերտ և 150 ուսուցիչ ներգրավվել են հարթակի վերապատրաստումների ծրագրում։

  • Եվրոպական միության կողմից ֆինանսավորվող և ՆԵՖ Բելգիայի կողմից իրականացվող «ՁԳՏՈՒՄ ավելի լավ ապագայի. համայնքների և քաղաքացիական հասարակության դիմակայունություն Հայաստանում» (STRIVE) ծրագրի շրջանակներում տեղայնացվել են ուսումնական նյութեր ֆիզիկա, քիմիա և կենսաբանություն առարկաներից, ինչպես նաև վերապատրաստվել եմ 90 ուսուցիչներ և 313 աշակերտներ Գեղարքունիք և Արմավիր մարզերից։ Մինչ այժմ «Քան» ակադեմիայի հայաստանյան գրասենյակն արդեն հայերենով և պետական չափորոշչին համապատասխան հասանելի է դարձրել շուրջ 4100-ից ավելի տեսանյութ, 38 000-ից ավելի վարժություններ և ուսուցողական նյութեր հետևյալ բաժիններից.

  • Մաթեմատիկա (տարրականից մինչև բարձրագույն մաթեմատիկա, շարված նաև ըստ դասարանների)

  • Բնական գիտություններ՝ քիմիա, ֆիզիկա, կենսաբանություն

  • Համակարգչային գիտություն և ծրագրավորում

  • Արվեստներ և հումանիտար գիտություններ (Անգլերենի քերականություն)

  • Ֆինանսներ և կապիտալի շուկա

  • Ձեռնարկատիրություն

  • Թեստերին նախապատրաստություն (SAT) Ցանկանում ենք մեր շնորհակալությունը հայտնել մեր աջակիցներին և բոլոր այն մարդկանց, ովքեր իրենց ներդրումն են ունեցել հարթակի տեղայնացման աշխատանքներում։

Մենք բաց ենք համատեղ ծրագրերի համար՝ հանուն հայալեզու կրթության տարածման։

Մենք հավատում ենք, որ Հայաստանում կան շատ մարդիկ, որ պատրաստ են աջակցելու և մասնակցելու հայալեզու առցանց կրթական նյութերի ստեղծմանն ու տարածմանը։

Եթե ցանկանում եք աջակցել «Քան» ակադեմիայի հայաստանյան գրասենյակին կամ համագործակցել, կարող եք գրել khanacademyarmenia@ayb.am էլփոստի հասցեին։

In July 2017, Ayb Educational Foundation kicked off the project of localization of Khan Academy platform and granted Armenian students and teachers an opportunity to receive high-quality education with one of the leading educational platforms of the world for free and in their native language.

The localization of the Math section started with the funding of the “Renaissance” Cultural and Intellectual Foundation, then, various organizations supported the localization work, as well as the work with stakeholders.

  • Within the frame of EU-funded “EU4Youth - SAY YES Skills for Jobs” project, co-financed by World Vision Armenia, Khan Academy Armenia expanded the localization and opened new sections, in particular Arts and Humanities, Entrepreneurship and Finance, Computer science and Programming.

  • With the funding of the US Embassy in Armenia, Khan Academy Armenia started the localization of science subjects, in particular resources in physics and organic chemistry, as well as trainings for about 40 STEM teachers and 900 students from Gyumri public schools aimed to help them use the platform for their teaching and learning.

  • 1500 students and 150 teachers from secondary schools got involved in the training program of Khan Academy Armenia within the framework of the “EU Covid-19 Solidarity Program for the Eastern Partnership” implemented by “People in Need Armenia”.

  • Withing the frame of STRIVE for a Better Future: Communities and Civil Society Resilience in Armenia (STRIVE) program, co-financed by the EU and implemented by NEF Belgium, Khan Academy Armenia expanded the localization, in particular Physics, Chemistry, Biology, as well as trained 90 teachers and 313 students in Armavir and Gegharkunik marzes. Since now, Khan Academy Armenia has already localized in Armenia and made it available for free and according to the state curriculum more than 4100 videos and 38 000 exercises and articles from the following sections:

  • Math (from early math to statistics and probability theory, ordered by grades)

  • Science (chemistry, biology, physics)

  • Computing and programming

  • Arts & Humanities (including English grammar)

  • Economics & Finance

  • Entrepreneurship

  • Test Prep (SAT)

  • Partner Content (Silicon Schools Fund and Clayton Christensen Institute) We still have much to do!

We are open to new collaborations.

We believe that there are many people in Armenia who are ready to support and participate in the creation and dissemination of the Armenian online educational materials.

If you want to learn more about how to collaborate with or contribute to Khan Academy Armenia please send us an email (khanacademyarmenia@ayb.am).

We would like to express our gratitude to our sponsors and those who contributed their time and efforts to localize the platform.

বাংলা দল / The Bangla team

Agami, a US-based non-profit organization (www.agami.org) has been collaborating with Khan Academy since 2011 to bring Khan Academy Bangla to Bangla-speaking learners from all over the world, and specially in Bangladesh. Through this collaboration the Khan Academy Bangla website was launched on March 1, 2016. While Agami is headquartered in Fremont, California, it’s Khan Academy Bangla team is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Agami’s work is funded by individual donations, and corporate/foundation grants.

For additional information and to support this initiative, please contact Dilruba Chowdhury (Khan Academy Bangla Language Advocate and Team Lead) at dilruba@agami.org.

Khan Academy Bangla’s operations are divided into three major areas:

  • Localization - the process of adapting contents through translating for local use
  • Content Development – mapping of localized content with local curriculum, identifying gaps and new content creation
  • Implementation – supporting schools to use Khan Academy Bangla by providing teacher training, student orientations, infrastructure verification/support, lesson planning and assessment material development. For more details, please check our Facebook page and website.

We would like to thank all the people who have helped us and continue to support us in making Khan Academy successful in Bangla. Below we mention the contributors, without whom we could not have done it!

In case, we missed someone accidentally, or you want to add/hide your name from the team list, please send an email to khanacademybangla@agami.org.

‘আগামী’(www.agami.org) একটি যুক্তরাষ্ট্রভিত্তিক অলাভজনক সংস্থা যা ২০১১ সাল থেকে ‘খান একাডেমি বাংলা’ কে বাংলাদেশসহ বিশ্বের সকল বাংলা ভাষাভাষীর কাছে পৌঁছে দেওয়ার লক্ষ্যে কাজ করছে। এরই ধারাবাহিকতায় ২০১৬ এর ১ মার্চ ‘খান একাডেমি বাংলা’র ওয়েবসাইট (bn.khanacademy.org) আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে যাত্রা শুরু করে। ‘আগামী’র ‘খান একাডেমি বাংলা’ দলের অবস্থান ঢাকা, বাংলাদেশে। ‘আগামী’র কার্যক্রমসমূহ সাধারণত ব্যক্তিগত এবং কর্পোরেট/ফাউন্ডেশন অনুদানের অর্থায়নে পরিচালিত হয়।

আরও তথ্য জানতে এবং এই কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা প্রদানে যোগাযোগ করুন এই ঠিকানায় - দিলরুবা চৌধুরী (খান একাডেমি বাংলা প্রোগ্রাম পরিচালক এবং মুখপাত্র)- dilruba@agami.org

খান একাডেমি বাংলার কার্যক্রমগুলোকে প্রধানত তিন ভাগে ভাগ করা যায় -

০১) লোকালাইজেশন - বিদ্যমান বিষয়গুলোকে বাংলাদেশের প্রেক্ষাপটে অনুবাদের মাধ্যমে ব্যবহার উপযোগী করার প্রক্রিয়া।

০২) কনটেন্ট ডেভেলপমেন্ট - দেশীয় শিক্ষাক্রমের সাথে ম্যাপ করে কনটেন্ট বা বিষয়গুলোর সাদৃশ্য ও বৈশাদৃশ্য নির্ণয় এবং বৈশাদৃশ্য অনুযায়ী প্রয়োজনীয় এবং নতুন কনটেন্ট তৈরি করা।

০৩) ইমপ্লিমেন্টেশন - শিক্ষক ও শিক্ষার্থী প্রশিক্ষণ, কাঠামো এবং অবকাঠামোগত সহযোগিতা যেমন, পাঠ পরিকল্পনা, মূল্যায়ন উপকরণ ইত্যাদি সরবরাহের মাধ্যমে বিদ্যালয়গুলোকে খান একাডেমি বাংলা ব্যবহারে সহযোগিতা করা।

বিস্তারিতভাবে জানতে লগইন করুন আমাদের ফেসবুক পেইজ www.facebook.com/KABangla এবং www.khanacademybangla.org ওয়েবসাইটে।

খান একাডেমি বাংলাকে সফলভাবে এগিয়ে নিয়ে যাওয়ার এই পথপ্ররিক্রমায় যারা এতদিন ধরে সহযোগিতা এবং সমর্থন যুগিয়ে আমাদের সাথে আছেন তাদের অসংখ্য ধন্যবাদ। যাদের কঠোর পরিশ্রম এবং আন্তরিক সহযোগিতায় এ কার্যক্রম সুন্দরভাবে পরিচালিত হয়েছে আমরা এখানে তাদের নামগুলো স্মরণ করছি -

(অনিচ্ছাকৃত ত্রুটিতে কারও নাম বাদ পড়ে গেলে অথবা কেউ নিজের নাম মুছে দিতে চাইলে এই ঠিকানায় লিখুন - khanacademybangla@agami.org)।

ქართული გუნდი / The Georgian team

ქართული საგანმანათლებლო ფონდი Educare Georgia (educaregeorgia.org) 2015 წლიდან აქტიურად მუშაობს „ხანის აკადემიის“ (ka.khanacademy.org) გაქართულებაზე. მისი მიზანია, ინტერნეტისა და თანამედროვე ტექნოლოგიების წყალობით საქართველოს ნებისმიერი მაცხოვრებლისთვის ხელმისაწვდომი გახადოს მსოფლიო დონის განათლება. ამისთვის ორგანიზაცია თარგმნის, ქმნის და ნერგავს საგანმანათლებლო რესურსებს და პროექტის GiveInternet.org დახმარებით ინტერნეტსა და ლეპტოპებს აწვდის სკოლის მოსწავლეებს (მოკლე მიმოხილვისთვის იხილეთ ვიდეო) „ხანის აკადემიის“ გაქართულებაში უდიდესი წვლილი მიუძღვით სწორედ იმ მოხალისეებსა და ფონდის თანამშრომლებს, რომლებიც დიდი ენთუზიაზმითა და თავდადებით თარგმნიან, ამონტაჟებენ და ქმნიან საგანმანათლებლო რესურსებს.

„ხანის აკადემია“ მადლობას უხდის თითოეულ მოხალისესა და თანამშრომელს: სწორედ მათი თავდაუზოგავი შრომით მივაღწევთ ჩვენს მისიას - უფასო, მსოფლიო დონის განათლებას ყველგან, ყველასთვის.

The educational foundation Educare Georgia (educaregeorgia.org) has been actively working on the localization of Khan Academy into the Georgian language since 2014. The mission of the nonprofit organization is to provide free access to world class education through the use of internet and modern technology. To accomplish the goal, the organization translates, creates and distributes educational material and provides school students with laptops and internet access through the GiveInternet.org project (see their video for more information). The Khan Academy localization process is made possible through the dedication, the persistent hard work and the enthusiasm of the volunteers and the staff members who translate, edit and create educational resources.

Khan Academy would like to thank all the volunteers and staff who’ve dedicated their time, energy, and expertise to our mission: a free, world-class education for anyone, anywhere.

한국팀 / The Korean Team

Founded in 2011 by Naver corporation, the NAVER Connect Foundation, a non-profit education foundation, set out in its mission and vision to give everyone the best educational opportunities based on new educational models and platforms.

​

The Foundation launched Khan Academy’s Korean versions for 18 courses in 2016 with the help provided by more than 2,000 translation volunteers, professional translators, and reviewers.

Since then almost 500 volunteers are currently making an effort to provide more Korean content.

​

We thank every one of our volunteers with all our hearts, helping to create access to Khan Academy’s high-quality content in Korean without the language barrier.

2011년 네이버가 설립한 비영리 교육 기관인 네이버 커넥트재단은 새로운 교육 모델과 플랫폼을 제공함으로써 누구나 최고의 교육기회를 가질 수 있게 하자는 목표를 가지고 있습니다.

2,000여 명이 넘는 번역 자원 봉사자, 전문 번역사, 감수자의 번역 활동에 힘입어, 2016년 18개 학습 과정을 갖춘 칸아카데미 한국어 버전을 오픈하였습니다.

​​이 후에도 현재, 약 500여명의 봉사자들이 더욱 많은 콘텐츠를 한국에서 학습할 수 있도록 번역하고 있습니다.

​

​칸아카데미의 수준 높은 콘텐츠를 한국에서도 언어 장벽 없이 배울 수 있도록 도움을 준 모든 자원 봉사자들에게 감사드립니다.

Navigating the reimagined experience

How do I browse courses and content in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Browse Subjects lets you explore courses and content across Khan Academy.

You can use Browse Subjects to learn something new, practice skills on your own, or explore content beyond your assigned work.

To open Browse Subjects, select Browse Subjects from the navigation menu.

Find a subject

Browse Subjects organizes content by subject area. Select a category to see the available courses.

Available subjects may include:

  • Math
  • English language arts (ELA)
  • Science
  • Social studies
  • Computing
  • Economics
  • Life skills
  • Test prep The courses available may change over time.

Open a course

Select any course to view its units, lessons, and activities.

From a course page, you can:

  • Browse units and lessons
  • Watch videos
  • Read articles
  • Complete exercises
  • Track your progress Note: Some courses may open in a separate Khan Academy window or tab. This is expected. Your progress will still be saved to your account.

Track your progress

Work completed through Browse Subjects still contributes to your learning progress.

As you practice, your skill levels may improve from:

  • Attempted
  • Familiar
  • Proficient
  • Mastered Earning Proficient on a skill also contributes to your weekly streak.

You can view your progress on your dashboard and on the Achievements page.

Browse Subjects and Gems

Browse Subjects is designed for self-directed learning.

While work completed through Browse Subjects contributes to your progress and streaks, it does not earn Gems.

Gems are earned through teacher-assigned work in your Learning Queue.

For more information, see How do I earn Gems in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Browse Subjects vs. Learning Queue

Browse Subjects is for exploring content on your own.

Your Learning Queue contains work assigned by your teacher.

If you’re looking for assigned work, start with your Learning Queue.

If you want to explore a topic, review a skill, or learn something new, Browse Subjects is a great place to start.

Return to content later

Your progress is saved automatically.

If you’d like to revisit something you’ve worked on, you can:

  • Return to the same course through Browse Subjects
  • Visit your History page to review recent activity

Need help?

If you need assistance, visit the Khan Academy Help Center or contact Khan Academy Support.

How do I use the student dashboard in Khan Academy?

Your student dashboard is your home base in Khan Academy. It’s where you can find assigned work, track your progress, view your Gems, and access the tools available to you.

What you’ll see on your dashboard

When you sign in, you’ll see several cards that help you track your progress at a glance.

Mastery Learning

The Mastery Learning card shows your progress toward becoming Proficient and Mastered in the skills you’ve been working on.

Missions Completed

The Missions Completed card shows how many Daily missions, Weekly missions, and Unit Missions you’ve completed.

Gem Challenge

The Gem Challenge card shows your class’s current Gem Challenge and your contribution toward the goal.

As you complete assigned work and earn Gems, your progress will update automatically.

My class

Near the top of your dashboard, you’ll see the class you’re currently viewing.

Use the dropdown menu to switch between classes if you’re enrolled in more than one class.

Learning Queue

Your Learning Queue is where you’ll find the work assigned by your teacher.

Assignments are organized into:

  • Daily missions for work due today and tomorrow
  • Weekly missions for work due later in the week
  • Unit Missions for work connected to a specific unit Work is sorted by due date so you can quickly see what to do next.

If you have overdue assignments, they’ll appear in your daily and weekly mission so you can catch up on missed work.

To see all assignments, select View all assignments.

For more information, see How do I use my Learning Queue in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Gems

You’ll find your Gem count near the top right of your dashboard. Click it for more information

You earn Gems by completing assigned work, including:

  • Exercises
  • Quizzes
  • Unit tests
  • Course challenges
  • Missions You never lose Gems once you’ve earned them.

Your teacher may also set a Gem Challenge for the class. Every Gem earned contributes toward the shared class goal. When the class reaches the goal, everyone unlocks the class reward.

You can customize your Khanmigo with Gems. Every 50 Gems unlocks a random accessory for Khanmigo.

For more information, see How do I earn Gems in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Streaks

Your streak tracks how many weeks in a row you’ve leveled up skills on Khan Academy.

To keep your streak going, earn Proficient on at least one new skill each week.

The weekly window runs from Monday through Sunday (Pacific Time). If no new skills reach Proficient during the week, your streak resets.

You can view your current streak on your dashboard and on your Achievements page.

Khanmigo

Depending on the features available at your school, Khanmigo may appear as a motivational companion or as a tutoring assistant.

If tutoring is enabled for your account, you can ask questions, get help with problems, and explore new topics.

Pages you can access from the navigation menu

The navigation menu on the left side of your screen gives you access to additional pages.

Tutor Me

Tutor Me lets you start a new conversation with Khanmigo.

If tutoring is available for your account, you can ask questions, get help with problems, or explore topics.

If tutoring is not available, you’ll see a message letting you know the feature isn’t enabled for your account.

Achievements

The Achievements page shows your progress and accomplishments.

Here, you can view:

  • Your Gems and Gem Challenge progress
  • Your Proficient skills
  • Your Mastered skills
  • Your current streak
History

History lets you review your past activity.

The Overview tab shows completed assignments and activities.

The Chat History tab shows previous conversations with Khanmigo.

Note: Chat History is only available if Khanmigo tutoring is enabled for your account.

Browse Subjects

Browse Subjects lets you explore courses and content across Khan Academy.

Use this page to discover topics that interest you or explore content beyond your assigned work.

Teacher-assigned work will always appear in your Learning Queue.

Settings

Settings lets you manage your account and customize your experience.

From Settings, you can:

  • Update your profile
  • Turn on accessibility features
  • Adjust video playback preferences
  • Change your preferred language Some settings may be managed by your school and may not be editable.

For more information, see How do I change my settings in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Help

Help takes you to the Khan Academy Help Center, where you can find answers to common questions and troubleshooting resources.

Log out

To log out, select your name at the bottom of the navigation menu.

Need help?

If you need assistance, visit the Khan Academy Help Center or contact Khan Academy Support.

Where can I find my assignments in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Your Learning Queue is where you’ll find the work assigned by your teacher. It helps you see what to work on next and keeps all of your assignments in one place.

Open your Learning Queue

To open your Learning Queue:

  • Select your class from the navigation menu.
  • Review your current assignments.

Understand Missions

Assignments in your Learning Queue are organized into Missions.

There are three types of Missions: Daily, Weekly, and Unit

Daily Mission

Your Daily Mission highlights the assignments that need your attention first, including work due today, tomorrow and any overdue assignments.

Your Daily Mission is built from your assigned work so you know what to focus on next.

Weekly Mission

Your Weekly Mission helps you plan ahead by showing assignments due later in the current week and the following week.

Like Daily Missions, Weekly Missions are automatically built from your assigned work.

Once you complete the Daily Mission, your Weekly Mission will appear (if there is work due).

Unit Mission

Unit Missions are assigned by your teacher and organized around a specific unit or topic.

To complete a Unit Mission, work through the assigned activities and build your skills toward Proficient and Mastered levels.

All work completed in Daily and Weekly Missions also counts toward your Unit Missions. You’re not doing extra work.

Start working on assignments

At the top of your Learning Queue, you’ll see your Daily Mission or Weekly Mission.

Select Start or Continue to jump into your next recommended assignment.

Below that, you’ll see your Unit Missions.

Each Unit Mission displays:

  • The unit name
  • Your progress toward Proficient skills
  • Any due dates or overdue work
  • A Start or Continue button

Choose a mission view

When you open a Mission, you can switch between two views.

Path view

Path view displays assignments as a visual learning journey.

Assignments appear along a path that helps guide you through the unit.

This view can be helpful if you prefer a more structured experience.

List view

List view displays assignments in a table format.

You can quickly see:

  • Assignment names
  • Due dates
  • Assignment types
  • Unit information This view can be helpful if you prefer to browse assignments directly.

You can switch between Path view and List view at any time.

Complete an assignment

Select any assignment to open it.

Depending on what your teacher assigned, you may see:

  • Exercises
  • Quizzes
  • Videos
  • Articles
  • Challenges
  • Unit tests
  • Course challenges Complete the activity and your progress will update automatically.

Track your progress

Each Unit Mission includes a skill counter near the unit title.

For example, you might see:

4 of 16 skills Proficient

This tells you:

  • How many skills are included in the unit
  • How many skills you’ve already reached Proficient on As you complete assignments and improve your skills, this counter updates automatically.

Daily Missions and Weekly Missions don’t include a skill counter because they can contain assignments from multiple units.

View all assignments

Select View all assignments from your Learning Queue to see every assignment across all Missions.

From this page, you can:

  • View upcoming and overdue assignments
  • Filter assignments
  • See assignment types
  • Review due dates
  • Track completed and incomplete work

Watch for due dates

Assignments include due dates set by your teacher.

If an assignment is past due, it will be marked as Overdue.

Overdue assignments remain visible until they are completed or removed by your teacher.

Earn Gems and maintain your streak

Completing assignments helps you earn Gems and build your streak.

You can earn Gems by reaching:

  • Proficient on a skill
  • Mastered on a skill You can use Gems to unlock accessories for Khanmigo through Khanmigo’s Collections.

Completing assignments also helps maintain your weekly streak. Earn at least one new Proficient skill each week to keep your streak going.

For more information, see How do I earn Gems in Khan Academy Reimagined?

Get help while you work

If Khanmigo tutoring is available for your account, Khanmigo can help you while you’re working on assignments.

You can:

  • Ask where to start
  • Get help choosing a strategy
  • Check your work
  • Ask follow-up questions

Finished all your assignments?

If you’ve completed all assigned work, your Learning Queue will show that you’re all caught up.

You can:

  • Wait for your teacher to assign more work
  • Explore content through Browse Subjects Note: Work completed through Browse Subjects can contribute to your mastery progress and streaks, but it does not earn Gems.

Need help?

If need assistance, visit the Khan Academy Help Center or contact Khan Academy Support..

Where can I view my skill progress in Khan Academy Reimagined?

As you complete exercises, quizzes, unit tests, and challenges, your skills progress through four mastery levels: Attempted, Familiar, Proficient, and Mastered.

Each mastery level has its own icon, which you’ll see throughout Khan Academy Reimagined.

You can view your skill progress in several places throughout Khan Academy Reimagined, from your class dashboard to your course pages.

On your class dashboard, you’ll find several places to view your skill progress:

  • Weekly mission – Track your progress toward completing your current mission.
  • Mastery learning – See the total number of skills you’ve reached at each mastery level.
  • Unit missions – Follow your progress through each unit and see how many skills remain before reaching Proficient. The sections below explain each view in more detail.

View your progress on your class dashboard

Your class dashboard includes several places where you can monitor your progress.

Mastery learning card

The Mastery learning card shows how many skills you’ve reached at each mastery level.

Daily and weekly missions

Your daily and weekly mission cards use mastery icons to show your progress toward completing your current mission.

Unit mission cards

Each unit mission card displays the mastery icons for every skill in the unit. It also includes a progress summary. For example, “3 of 22 skills to Proficient”, so you can quickly see how many skills remain before reaching your goal.

View your progress in your learning path or list view

Each skill in your learning path and list view displays its current mastery icon, making it easy to see which skills you’ve already progressed in and which are ready for more practice.

View your progress after an activity

When you finish an exercise, quiz, unit test, or challenge, you’ll see the mastery level you earned for that skill as part of your results.

This lets you immediately see how your performance affected your progress.

View your progress on a course page

Course pages provide an overview of your progress across an entire course.

Mastery icons appear next to every skill, making it easy to identify your progress across each unit and the course as a whole.

Content Update: [MCAT | Test Prep] Biological and Biochemical Foundations of Living Systems (BBLS) Passages

Hi, everyone!

We are thrilled to announce content improvements we have made to the Khan Academy MCAT course! These improvements include passage, question, and explanation updates to over 80 Biological and Biochemical Foundations of Living Systems (BBLS) passages included in the course. The BBLS practice passages can be found in Unit 2 of the Khan Academy MCAT course, titled “Practice Passages: Biological and Biochemical Foundations of Living Systems.”

What improvements were made to these passages?

  1. Passage organization by foundation and topic: BBLS passages are now organized by foundation and topic, which makes them easier to navigate and aligns them with the video-based lessons in the Khan Academy MCAT course.

  • Metabolism Topics include:

  • Organelles

  • Cell studies Topics include:

  • Skin

  1. Passage and question improvements: Updates to the passages have increased the variety of research studies and graphical data included in Khan Academy passages and have better aligned the passage style with the MCAT exam. The updated passages also include more Skill 3 and Skill 4 questions, to offer extra practice with research and data analysis questions.

Examples of research-based figures covered in the new passages are shown below:

  1. Explanation improvements: All BBLS MCAT questions now come with helpful hints and clear explanations. Many include helpful images to aid in content learning and graphical analysis. Examples of explanation graphics are shown below:

How should I use the new BBLS passages to study?

Option 1: Study the BBLS passages, topic by topic, as you progress through the video-based lessons found in units 5-7 of the Khan Academy MCAT course, which cover Foundation 1 (Biomolecules), Foundation 2 (Cells), and Foundation 3 (Organ Systems). This will allow you to learn how to apply MCAT concepts to passages as you study the content.

Option 2: After you’ve completed your BBLS content review, go through the BBLS passages in order. This will provide a valuable review of the content and prepare you for the AAMC practice materials.

Option 3: If you’re limited on time, study only the new BBLS passages covering areas in which you need more support — e.g. if you struggle with nervous system-based questions or content, then find those passages. It will be easy to find specific passages now that BBLS passages are organized by foundation and topic.

Find the new Khan Academy passages at khanacademy.org.
